purpose: Reviewed target-selection contract for the DM1 PC 3.4 post-dungeon capture route. Every post-dungeon route receipt that aims at a creature-chain / champion-panel / wall-door-fakewall / viewport / collision pairing target must be backed by a target_selection.json that this contract validates. The contract does not promote parity; it pins the selection step so the operator cannot ship an unreviewed target into the next DOSBox live attempt.

assetSet.game: Dungeon Master PC DOS English v3.4

globalRules.routeStyle: The post-dungeon route grammar is the same comma-separated Keypad-N[:label] list the live runner accepts at --post-dungeon-route (see docs/parity/tools/dosbox_capture_session.py --self-test-post-dungeon-route).
globalRules.passagePin: Every selection must reference at least one PASS_ID the live attempt is meant to advance (e.g. pass1058, pass1059, pass1071). The selector rejects selection_rationale that does not cite a known PASS_ID.
preconditions: runbook step 5b.1 requires the live runner to have produced original/<NN>_<label>.png frames + dosbox_capture.post_dungeon_route.json before a target selection is retroactively considered reviewed; the reviewed-selection receipt is the gate, not the route receipt
the canonical preflight receipt (docs/parity/tools/dosbox_capture_preflight.py) must be reachable on disk for the selector to emit its reviewed-selection receipt
nonClaims: This contract does not promote original-vs-Firestaff pixel parity.

Selecting a reviewed target does not authorize promoting a parity row; pairing rows in docs/parity/DM1_V1_CAPTURE_GAP_EVIDENCE.md remain partial until the original frame bytes are paired against an indexed Firestaff fixture.
The selector does not launch DOSBox or read live frames; the validator runs hermetically against the selection JSON + the contract.
Reviewed target selection is an accountability gate; it does not make a partial capture into a full one.

kindContracts.summary: Step into (or near) a level-1 group line-of-sight so a Trolin or similar documented creature shows up in D2C and possibly D1C of the original viewport.

sourceAnchors.claim: creature draw, pose, flip, depth palette, and viewport compositing route
I34E creature aspect table; Trolin is type 16

minimumSemanticChecks: reviewer_pass_id matches the live route's PASS_ID

kindContracts.summary: Trigger a champion-candidate or champion-mirror panel so a 4-champion HUD or single-champion status-box frame is reachable without leaving dungeon_gameplay.

sourceAnchors.claim: champion status-box + portrait + bar-graph draw order
inventory slot-box / hand-slot draw path that pass1061 / pass1062 gate against

minimumSemanticChecks: selected_panel_kind in {four_champion_hud, single_champion_status, candidate_panel, mirror_panel, inventory_hand_slot}
panel_trigger_source describes a source-locked command sequence (C094 click, slot click, mouse_capture + Keypad-5, etc.)
reviewer_pass_id matches the live route's PASS_ID

kindContracts.summary: Step forward so the camera rests on a wall, an alcove, a closed door, a fakewall, or an open/fakewall-toggle boundary to expose one of the documented wall/door states to viewport-pixel pairing.

sourceAnchors.claim: D1C door/front frame, button, and door panel draw order

minimumSemanticChecks: selected_boundary_kind in {wall_closeup, alcove_front_left, alcove_front_right, closed_door, fakewall, runtime_open_door, button_door}
expected_visual_edge matches the selected_boundary_kind edge family
reviewer_pass_id matches the live route's PASS_ID

kindContracts.summary: Capture a deterministic 3x3 viewport neighborhood without rotating or stepping so the original-vs-Firestaff overlay remains comparable to a Firestaff fixture row.

sourceAnchors.claim: viewport redraw on tick, consuming map/X/Y/direction tuple
VIDRV_09_BlitViewPort present boundary for the 224x136 viewport crop

minimumSemanticChecks: locked_party_tuple is a 4-tuple map_index/x/y/direction with direction in 0..3
reviewer_pass_id matches the live route's PASS_ID

kindContracts.summary: Drive party/tile collisions (wall, closed door, fakewall, open door, button door, party-occupied, diagonal) into a deterministic stasis so the same path on Firestaff replays the same collision response.

sourceAnchors.claim: movement commits G0306/G0307 only when no blocker blocked the move

minimumSemanticChecks: selected_block_kind in {wall, closed_door, fakewall, party_occupied, diagonal_blocked}
reviewer_pass_id matches the live route's PASS_ID

forbiddenSelectionPatterns.name: short_route_no_anchor
forbiddenSelectionPatterns.description: Routes that do not pin a pass_id plus a kind contract minimum step count together cannot be reviewed. The selector refuses if routeSteps.length < kindContract.minimumRouteSteps OR reviewer_pass_id is unset.

forbiddenSelectionPatterns.name: reviewer_unset
forbiddenSelectionPatterns.description: Reviewed target selection must list a reviewer name + reviewer_run_id. The selector refuses if either is empty.

forbiddenSelectionPatterns.name: non_claims_missing
forbiddenSelectionPatterns.description: The selector requires a non_claims list with at least the three baseline entries: 'pixel parity not promoted', 'proprietary frame bytes stay operator-local', 'selector is accountability, not promotion'.

forbiddenSelectionPatterns.name: preflight_pin_required
forbiddenSelectionPatterns.description: The selector refuses if the cited preflight receipt path is missing or has not been written by an on-disk preflight invocation. The selector pre-flight reads the receipt and refuses if the SHA pin checks are not all PASS.

nonClaims: No original-vs-Firestaff pixel parity is promoted by this contract.
No proprietary game frames are tracked, paired, or promoted.
No new tool changes any DM1 V1 / ReDMCSB source-locked behavior; this contract governs the operator's reviewed-target-selection step only.
Selecting a reviewed target does not retire any B1 / B3 capture-gap row. The pairing rows in docs/parity/DM1_V1_CAPTURE_GAP_EVIDENCE.md keep their existing labels until paired artifacts exist.
